$comment: Fact-flow sidecar (Posudek 17): which namespace keys (contracts/facts.v1.json) this module's capabilities consume and produce. A sidecar on purpose — module-descriptor.v1.schema.json is frozen. Keys only, never values; capability set must equal descriptor.json (FACT-004). v1 extracts exactly four fields (VC §5 MUST set); supplier.vatId is deliberately NOT listed — declaring it would be inventing a fact the handler never produces.
